phase_field_branch_review.finding: EquivalentStress draft uses sigma_c and stress softening, degrades reconstruction with g(d), and optionally splits stress. It predates PFPD v1 and contains no AT1 crack energy, Yc constrained minimizer, or separate early h=1. It is not an official PFPD evolution implementation and does not resolve Eq3.25.
